components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main call-to-action button for primary interactions. Indigo background with white text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #6366F1; color: #F8FAFC; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.5), inset 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.06); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4F46E5; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 4px 14px -2px rgba(0,0,0,0.6), inset 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.06), 0 0 24px -4px rgba(99,102,241,0.25); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #312E81; transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-btn-primary[disabled] { background: #475569; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Ghost/secondary button variant for secondary actions. Surface card background with border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #111827; color: #F8FAFC; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; border: 1px solid #1F293D; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #162032; border-color: #2E3A52; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Primary container component for dashboard content and data display.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #111827; color: #F8FAFC; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid #1F293D; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px -2px rgba(0,0,0,0.6), inset 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.06); padding: 1.5rem; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.3); box-shadow: 0 4px 20px -4px rgba(99,102,241,0.25); }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Small status indicator for tags, priority levels, and category badges.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .ds-badge-primary { background: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.15); color: #C084FC; border: 1px solid rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.3); } .ds-badge-positive { background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1); color: #34D399; border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2); } .ds-badge-negative { background: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.1); color: #FB7185; border: 1px solid rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.2); }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation
components.description: Persistent left sidebar navigation with collapsible mobile support.
components.css: .ds-sidebar-nav { width: 256px; background: #0A0E17; border-right: 1px solid #1F293D; padding: 1rem; } .ds-nav-link { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: 0.75rem; color: #94A3B8; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; transition: all 0.2s; } .ds-nav-link:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); color: #F8FAFC; } .ds-nav-link.active { background: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.15); color: #C084FC; border-left: 3px solid #6366F1; }

narrative.overview: LocalPulse AI presents a sophisticated dark-mode interface that transforms complex customer intelligence into actionable business insights. The design emphasizes data density without clutter, using a high-contrast color system where indigo accents draw attention to critical actions while emerald and rose indicate sentiment direction. Every visual element serves the busy local business owner who needs to quickly scan and act on intelligence signals.
keyCharacteristics: Dark premium aesthetic with navy canvas (#090D16)
Strategic color scarcity - indigo used sparingly for impact
Clean typography with tabular numbers for analytics precision
Subtle glow effects for interactive states, not static decoration
Data-dense yet scannable with consistent 8px baseline grid

rules.name: The Scarcity Rule
rules.body: The primary indigo accent is used on ≤10% of visible interactive elements. Its rarity makes each primary action feel intentional.

rules.name: The Layered Depth Rule
rules.body: Shadows indicate state (hover, elevation, focus) rather than static hierarchy. Tonal differences create depth between surfaces.

rules.name: The CTA Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Only one primary CTA per view. Secondary actions use outline or ghost variants.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: All analytics and metrics use tabular figures (font-tabular) for consistent alignment.

dos: Use tabular numbers for all analytics (font-tabular) to maintain alignment.
Use indigo sparingly for primary CTAs—their impact comes from scarcity.
Use the glow effects (glow-cyan, glow-indigo) only on interactive hover states, not static elements.
Maintain 1.5rem-2rem internal padding in cards for scannability.
Show data with supporting evidence—a demand score always links to verbatim quotes.
donts: Don't use indigo on passive or decorative elements—reserve for actions.
Don't add borders to the main canvas—use tonal layering instead.
Don't use drop shadows on static cards—only for modals and elevated states.
Don't truncate business names in the sidebar—use truncation classes.
Don't display demand score without supporting review quotes.
